address: à la tour de Nonza, Nonza, 20217, France
bio: This unusual restaurant, without an inside dining room, nestles at the foot of the watchtower built by Paoli (18C), a veritable crow's nest, perched 160m up, offering an exceptional view over the coast of Cap Corse and Saint Florent bay. The terraces with their many nooks and crannies mean you can enjoy the good, Corsican - accented Mediterranean cuisine with a certain amount of intimacy....
